## Changes

- `scripts/test-assurance/s3.mjs` + `scripts/test-assurance/s3.test.mjs` — S3 reconciliation engine and its 70-case companion: custody/unknown-refusal/NUL-identity semantics, coherent unactivated-ledger fixture (cd3 baseline + both optional guard rows with content-derived pins served through a bounded pass-through runner), case46 discharged by the admitted data, not by assertion changes.
- `packages/core/hooks/checks/guard-liveness.ts` + `guard-liveness.test.ts` — guard liveness: `getChangedFilesVsBase`/`runTestQualityGate` optional `rootDir` seams (production callers keep REPO_ROOT), frozen-SOURCE classifier, and the mutation lab (48/48): durable Git-fixture caller test with real twins, actually-executed overaccept-TARGET + trim-after-NUL mutants, MUTANT-HASHES triplets with comparable rebound baselines.
- `scripts/test-assurance/verify.mjs` — Root-admitted whole V: the two unique `S2.subjects` guard pins renewed to the committed guard bytes (one-line renewal, 65135bb6… → 80618278…).
- `docs/test-assurance-kernel/s3/scope-extension.json` — Root-admitted whole L: activated ledger binding the delivered bytes (s3.mjs e5a80f46…, s3.test.mjs 8aa48fac…, verify.mjs 80618278…, MANIFEST 3acd994c…, + the two optional guard rows b599c8c1…/4efc1db2… in fixed order).
- `packages/getff/MANIFEST.sha256` — normal MF producer renewal (1677 rows; delta exactly the two causally changed guard rows).
- TAK evidence/method files (`docs/test-assurance-kernel/**`, errata, provenance comment fixes) and the site-prose Docs-card-for claims for the graph commits.

Unit-47 repair of the unit-46 seed (transported verbatim from the retained
T WIP by the Root-admitted five-postimage seed patch, then repaired in
place). Five repairs, same five paths, no fixture/oracle edits:

1. Test custody: every unit-46/47 test fixture now lives in an exclusively
   owned unique scratch root (mkdtemp under gitignored /.ai-factory/ or
   os.tmpdir()) with the existing isolated lifecycle; the canonical
   repo-root TARGET directory and the exact store membership are asserted
   absent/unchanged before and after the whole block. The seed arms that
   wrote/removed the canonical recovery-d011-population directory and
   canonical SOURCE-store names are gone.
2. Unknown selected test-bearing input inside either SOURCE store is now a
   HARD failure (healthy or bad bytes alike) — store prefixes detect
   unknowns, they never authorize them. The seed silently passed unknown
   healthy inputs through the ordinary lint lane.
3. getChangedFilesVsBase emits NUL-delimited exact filenames (git diff -z,
   no quoting, no octal escaping, no trim) — a committed UTF-8 path and a
   whitespace twin can never collapse onto a known SOURCE spelling.
4. The exact-30 map and two-store projection are runtime-immutable
   (Object.freeze): no caller can add an unknown path/hash pair, extend
   the store tuple, or rewrite a canonical pin.
5. The misleading seed claims are replaced by real counterfactuals: an
   owned mutation lab runs genuine classifier-disabled and
   over-rejecting-healthy mutants of the production module as real
   subprocesses through the exported production entry (RED), then the
   un-mutated healed copy (GREEN), with original/mutated/canonical hashes
   asserted — plus a real Git caller proof over two actual committed
   changes (the fixture-adding 8fdb2ee and the UTF-8-named eedaf12a
   research patch) and the real production gate over that historical
